end_market_exposure.detail: Fuel ethanol for gasoline blending; distillers grains for livestock feed; corn oil; buys corn from local farmers.

manufacturing_type.detail: Continuous corn dry-mill fermentation and distillation producing ethanol and co-products.

notes: Product details beyond the bio-energy facility come from prior knowledge of the Minnesota plant; the website evidence is mostly corn bids.

product_complexity.detail: Ethanol, distillers grains and corn oil are commodity products priced off market benchmarks.

production_model.detail: Produces continuously for stock and sells commodity ethanol and co-products through marketers.

production_role.detail: Produces ethanol and co-products sold to blenders and feed users; processes farmer-supplied corn.

sub_sector.value: corn ethanol production; distillers grains and corn oil co-products
